articles.title: These Faraway Planets Are Fluffier Than Cotton Candy!
articles.summary: Imagine a planet so light it could float in a giant bathtub! Astronomers found two Jupiter-sized planets, TOI-791 b and c, that are less dense than cotton candy. They orbit a star 1,113 light-years away.

articles.title: This Tiny Computer Uses DNA and a Drop of Water to Do Math
articles.summary: Scientists built a computer that uses DNA in a drop of water to solve math problems. It's super efficient and could one day work inside our bodies!

articles.title: This Scientist Says He Can Stop Aging in 3 Years!
articles.summary: A 74-year-old scientist claims he can create an anti-aging pill that makes us feel 25 again. He's been working on it since he was 10 years old!
